Headline results for run /home/hyoklee/poro/agent/results/run_20261115T155359Z_s20 (read-only report; no PBS jobs submitted, hazard.py not run):

RECORDS & DETECTIONS
- Records analysed: 759 (stride 20; window 2016-03-18T02:09:17Z to 2016-03-26T00:59:44Z, 3.314% of the time span)
- Anomalous records (|robust z| > 5): 57
- DAS detections: 62 in 53 records; relative b = 0.9849 (34 above Mc)
- Pumping over the 15.96-day window: injected 4.654e+05 m3, extracted 5.059e+05 m3, net -4.048e+04 m3
- Catalogue (GDR 859, LBNL/NCEDC March 2016): 5 events, ML -0.48 to 0.07

CALIBRATED PROBABILITIES (catalogue-based, Shapiro et al. 2021 Eq. 5 — the LBNL catalogue calibration):
  b      Sigma      P(M>=5.5)/yr   P(M>=5.5) over observed volume   P(M>=3)/yr
  1.0    -5.449     0.0001198      5.236e-06                        0.03719
  0.73   -5.319     0.004922       0.0002155                        0.2809
  0.65   -5.281     0.01474        0.0006484                        0.4653

DAS-BASED UPPER BOUND (uncalibrated magnitudes; every DAS detection counted as an event at/above the catalogue Mc, so it OVER-COUNTS):
  b = 0.9849, Sigma = -2.698, P(M>=5.5)/yr = 0.07842

INTERPRETATION
- The calibrated numbers are the catalogue-based (LBNL/NCEDC, Shapiro et al. 2021 Eq. 5) Sigma and P(Mw>=5.5) values per b scenario — these are the ones to trust for hazard.
- The DAS-based P(Mw>=5.5)/yr = 0.07842 is an upper bound only: DAS magnitudes are uncalibrated and all 62 detections are treated as events at/above Mc, so it over-counts; it should not be read as a calibrated probability.
- Either way, the data show no evidence of injection-induced seismicity approaching a Pohang-like Mw>=5.5 event: calibrated annual probabilities range from ~1.2e-4 (b=1.0) to ~1.5e-2 (b=0.65), and even the over-counting DAS upper bound is 0.078/yr, against a background of only 5 small catalogue events (ML<=0.07) during a net-negative (extractive) injection period.
